summary: Iteration 24 — Verified the fix that exposes the new Patient directory + Invite conversion tiles on the staff Patients bottom tab (via staff-patient-db.tsx). Backend 7/7 pytests pass against the public URL with owner token (registry summary, invite analytics, invite batches, bulk invite). Frontend UI test on /tools confirms: (1) 'Patient directory' tile (testID patient-db-open-directory) renders with live subtitle 'Unregistered · 5   ·   Registered · 2'; (2) 'Invite → sign-up conversion' tile (testID patient-db-invite-analytics) renders with '0 of 2 walk-ins signed up · 0%' because total_invited > 0; (3) tapping the directory tile navigates to /patients and the Unregistered/Registered/All pill tabs render; (4) existing Patient Database features (header, search input, month pills, Export CSV, patient list) are still present — no regression. Deprecated style warnings detected (pre-existing): 'shadow*'/'textShadow*' style props and props.pointerEvents (React Native web deprecations, not this iteration).

issues: Screenshot shows a persistent left-side web navigation drawer occupying ~50% of the 390px mobile viewport (Home / Book / Inbox / Dashboard / etc.), squeezing the 'Patient Database' title into ~1 character per line. Appears pre-existing in the web-preview layout, not caused by this iteration; flagging for main-agent visibility.

react_native_issues.issue: React-Native-Web deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' and 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated — should use 'boxShadow' / 'textShadow' shorthand. Reference: multiple files (framework-wide).
props.pointerEvents is deprecated — should use style.pointerEvents.
'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported' warning on web. Non-fatal but noisy.

action_items: None required for this iteration — the reported bug is FIXED. The two new tiles are visible on the Patients bottom-tab screen for owner/staff role and navigate correctly to /patients.
Optional cleanup (unrelated to this iter): sweep 'shadow*' / 'textShadow*' style props to boxShadow/textShadow and props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
Optional: investigate why the web-preview mobile viewport shows a persistent side drawer eating half the screen — squeezes header layout to single-char columns.
critical_code_review_comments: staff-patient-db.tsx (600 lines) is approaching the 700-line soft cap; consider splitting the row-card + pill components into a sibling file for future maintainability.

The two /registry endpoints are fetched with Promise.all + .catch(()=>({data:null})) which is fine, but summary is silently absent on failure — subtitle then falls back to a static 'Registered · Unregistered · Duplicates · Bulk invite' string. That's acceptable but consider a subtle retry or error toast if the endpoint 500s so the owner knows counts are stale.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: Two similar screens (staff-patient-db.tsx and staff-patients-screen.tsx) existed. Prior iterations added new features (multi-select bulk invite, invite analytics) only to /patients (staff-patients-screen). Bottom-tab routed to /tools which mounts staff-patient-db.tsx for staff — so users never saw the new features. Fix: added a 'Patient directory' tile + 'Invite → sign-up conversion' tile to staff-patient-db.tsx that both navigate to /patients, and hydrate their subtitles/values from /api/registry/patients/summary + /api/registry/invites/analytics on mount. Verified end-to-end in this iteration.
